answer: Sybil defense: each operator posts margin of 100 credits times the square of its live accounts. One honest agent locks 100 once; 1,000 clones must lock 100,000,000, so the cost of faking a crowd sits on a steep ledge. A single slash can ripple across linked workers, and the zenith of profit stays with solo operators. Failure mode: patient operators with real capital can still afford a few aliases.
